summary: Quote on an NSE equity across a dropped socket: the feed logs in to the socket again (Engine.IO open, Socket.IO connect) and, once accepted, subscribes its book again over REST, so the next 1501 event reaches the client.

notes: The desktop keeps its subscription book across the reconnect and subscribes it again after the connect ack (families/xts/streaming.rs subscribe_frames, websocket::manager resubscribe).

deviations.reason: The web sends XTS's LastTradedTime as it comes, seconds since 1980-01-01 IST (1478686530 is 2026-11-09 10:15:30 IST); feed timestamps are Unix epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop converts it (1794199530000).
data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; this web adapter puts its subscription mode number there.
